ISL: Rikisendurskodun's own published-reports index was opened and enumerated, not searched for. https://www.rikisendurskodun.is/skyrslur has a GET form with three filters (searchString1 year, searchString2 publication type, searchString3). Filtering type = 'Endurskodunarskyrsla' (value 2) with 'Oll ar' (all years) and paging through pageIndex=1..8 (https://www.rikisendurskodun.is/skyrslur?pageIndex=N&CurrentFilter1=0&CurrentFilter2=1&CurrentFilter3=0) returns 126 per-entity audit reports, covering financial years 2016 to 2021. The titles were extracted in full and read: they name ministries, universities, hospitals, police districts, sheriffs, funds, the Competition Authority, Bankasysla rikisins (the State Financial Investments agency) and the Landspitali, and Sedlabanki Islands is ABSENT from the entire list. That is the inversion test: the institution that is the central bank's statutory auditor publishes an entity-by-entity audit report series and the central bank is not in it, so there is no published Rikisendurskodun audit report on the Central Bank of Iceland in that series. What is NOT closed: the second publication category on the same index, 'Skyrsla til Althingis' (searchString2=2), was not enumerated, and the free-text search at /leit renders its results in JavaScript and returned only the static filter page to curl (two different query strings returned byte-identical 20,763-byte pages, so nothing was tested there). althingi.is is behind a Cloudflare interstitial to curl (HTTP 403, 5,504 bytes on /altext/144/s/1001.html) and should be tried with WebFetch next round.
